RIGHT OUTPUT = corrected existing frame5: same NW rear-left recovery body and foot/skirt configuration as target5, distinct settled head/shoulder/near-left empty wrist position, same farRIGHT lowered weapon arm returning after attack. Keep SAME original body pixel proportions/scale in both, head-to-boot size comparable to reference1, comfortable transparent safety margins around ALL rays, hair, long skirt, boots and entire long curved weapon.
